title: Start with data. Shape a story.
summary: A distinct original browser recording becomes a focused dashboard promo by omitting waits and preserving readable requests and results.

inputs.label: Original dashboard browser recording
inputs.description: A 44-second original scripted browser fixture: weekly demonstration figures become a dashboard, then chat focuses returning customers. Deliberate waits test interval selection. This is not a shipping service or live model session.

inputs.label: Exact copy and focus hints
inputs.description: Supplied product name, exact titles, colors, timestamp hints, and named source regions. The workflow preserves this wording and the actual recording pixels.

stages.label: Inspect the recording
stages.description: Validate the source and sample its chronology before any paid call.

stages.label: Refine a saved editable plan
stages.description: The structured model selected four chronological source intervals and camera times. The caller expanded the canvas crop left edge to retain the complete filename; timing and intervals are unchanged. The original source fixture row count and chart-label alignment were corrected before final review.

stages.label: Render exact source pixels
stages.description: Local typography and camera framing render the saved plan at $0. Explicit cuts retain the completed requests and outcomes. Strict full-file decoding validates the delivered MP4.

stages.label: Independent sampled review
stages.description: A different model accepted all eight criteria on timestamped frames, the full-size poster, exact-copy brief, and report.

limitations: The source is original DOM/CSS rendered by Chromium at authored timeline positions. Browser fixture creation is optional and separate from the recording-to-promo utility.

One silent 1920 × 1080 composition with explicit chronological source intervals. Caller-approved cuts omit waits and independently retime retained footage; narration, sound design, device mockups and larger edits remain outside this utility.
Independent review covers sampled visual evidence and a static poster, not continuous motion or listening. Source and final MP4 decoding are structural checks.
This is a distinct-input transfer study alongside the selected Garden example; a few inputs do not establish a general success rate.
